source_fact_policy: Every factual proposition is a disposition over an exact V3 ledger claim ID. No browser observation, catalog analogy, or uncited source fact is added.

scene_state_transition_model.statement: The current catalog identity is dragon-rider / Dragon Rider with the recorded cover and playable status; the locale page module imports DragonRiderGame, loads vocabulary through the dragon-rider API, and posts completion results to the completion API.
The core reducer status is running or boss, while the component UI phase is start, playing, or ended; these are distinct state machines.
A new core run starts running with elapsedMs 0, attempts 0, correctAnswers 0, dragonCount 1, and a 150000 ms default duration.
The logical stage defaults to 960x540; buildLayout computes gate centers, player and boss positions, with gate and sprite-scale clamping.
While playing/running, the component advances core time every 60 ms, moves one gate pair toward the bottom, and applies difficulty-dependent travel times of 9000, 7200, 5500, or 4000 ms.

A gate selection records a pending outcome, targets the selected gate center, locks the pair, and resolves when the player lerps near that target; resolution updates attempts, answers, and dragon count.

The core gate transition ignores non-running state, increments attempts, increments correctAnswers only for a correct side, changes dragonCount by plus or minus one floored at one, and creates the next round.
Core time clamps elapsed time to durationMs and changes running to boss when the duration is reached, while ignoring non-running states.
The scene declares and loads gates, boss, player, playerCamera, dragon army, three parallax layers, and loading background through the vocabulary/dragon-rider public asset paths.
The component exposes keyboard ArrowLeft/A and ArrowRight/D input and left/right pointer buttons using onPointerDown while playing.
The component measures its container with ResizeObserver, window resize/orientationchange, and visualViewport resize/scroll, then stores rounded dimensions as stageSize.

mechanics_learning_model.statement: Each round presents a term, correct translation, decoy translation, and correct left/right side; empty vocabulary yields empty strings with left as the correct side, while non-empty vocabulary selects a distinct decoy when possible.
Selecting a gate is the atomic learning interaction: the selected side determines correctness, and the core updates attempts, correct answers, dragon count, and the next round.
The visible traversal to a gate precedes score mutation: selection creates a pending correct/incorrect outcome and only gate-target resolution updates counters and dragon count.

Keyboard and pointer controls expose the left/right choice surface, and the retained core and component test sources cover initialization, gate selection, timer-to-boss, boss power, result calculation, start/running rendering, keyboard selection, and boss-to-results status.
